# Gutsaga Technologies — Horizon inventory-flow control platform

> Gutsaga Technologies (gutsaga.tech) builds Horizon: an inventory-flow management-control platform
> for retail chains, distributors and wholesalers with 1,000+ SKUs. Inventory-management work since 2004.
> Since 2005, founder Serzas Gutsaga worked within the TOC / Inherent Simplicity / Symphony ecosystem.
> Horizon evolved from that implementation experience and from GT-created extensions to conventional buffer management.
> GT technologies have been used across 10,000+ stores, points of sale and warehouses.
> Results: availability up to 99.5%, stock down 10-40% without losing sales,
> sales up 2-20% from availability, manual ordering time down up to 85%.
> Not forecast-based and not a black box: targets respond to real inventory
> adequacy per SKU-location, under ordering rules managers see and set.
> Unique: full day-by-day history of lost sales and overstock at every level.
> Entry point: FREE DEMO, up to 2 months — a diagnostic (real simulation on the client's own
> historical data) plus daily monitoring dashboards on current data. No integration project.
> Contact: info@gutsaga.tech
